info.name: TableCheck API - V1 availability shops API
Search for availability across all shops

params.name: pax
params.description: Desired number of guests for which to search for availability.

params.name: datetime
params.description: Desired datetime around which to search for availability.

params.name: mini
params.description: If true, returns only availablity without including shop info.

params.name: ids
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific IDs to return.

params.name: slugs
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific slugs to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The zero-based page number. Used for pagination.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items to return at once. Used for pagination.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field by which to sort the results. Distance sort is applied only if geo parameters are present.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: asc or desc.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by the shop name.

params.name: geo_latitude
params.description: The latitude of the geocode center point used to evaluate distance query.

params.name: geo_longitude
params.description: The longitude of the geocode center point used to evaluate distance query.

params.name: geo_distance
params.description: The maximum distance in meters from the geocode center point from which to return results.

params.name: cuisines
params.description: Filter by a list of cuisine values (array or comma-separated list)

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter by a list of tag values (array or comma-separated list)

params.name: seat_types
params.description: Filters availability by the type of seating, e.g. table, counter, private room, etc. (array or comma-separated list)

params.name: smoking
params.description: Filters availability by whether the seating allows smoking or not. If unspecified, both smoking and non-smoking are allowed.

params.name: service_modes
params.description: Service mode selection of dining, pickup, etc. (array or comma-separated list)

params.name: budget_lunch_min
params.description: Minimum of lunch budget range filter.

params.name: budget_lunch_max
params.description: Maximum of lunch budget range filter.

params.name: budget_dinner_min
params.description: Minimum of dinner budget range filter.

params.name: budget_dinner_max
params.description: Maximum of dinner budget range filter.

params.name: address_city
params.description: Filter by the shop's address city, ward, or municipality.

params.name: address_region
params.description: Filter by the shop's address region, state, or province.

params.name: address_postal_code
params.description: Filter by the shop's address postal code.

params.name: address_country
params.description: Filter by the shop's address country.

params.name: search_after
params.description: Use for pagination. Set this value to obtain the next page of results.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (whitelist). If specified, only the listed fields will be returned. Supports dot notation for nested fields.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from the response (blacklist). All fields except the given ones will be returned. Supports dot notation for nested fields.

items.docs: Search for availability across all shops

params.name: shop_id
params.description: The id or slug of the shop to retrieve

params.name: include_fields

params.name: exclude_fields
